text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Working without pause must have left your 
throat dry. Have some tea. 
It is gyokuro from a teahouse I am fond 
of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thanked her and accepted the cup. 
Taking a sip—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! 
You speak the truth. What a dreadful waste 
of fine tea...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems I misjudged the water's 
temperature... 
—I shall brew another cup. Wait here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An uncharacteristic mistake for her. 
She might be exhausted... 
It would be wise to reconsider our race 
schedule.
